1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with adequate letter and line spacing across all screens.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case without italics or all-caps, and text blocks remain short rather than dense.

3.why: Content is presented in a narrow centered card layout that remains readable and well spaced at mobile widths.

4.why: Instructions are brief and use plain language such as 'Enter your registered details' and 'Confirm code'.

5.why: No example format is shown for the expected six-digit authenticator code or other inputs.

6.why: The user is not required to read any long block of text; each step has only one or two short sentences.

7.why: The long setup secret is displayed in a selectable field so it can be copied, but no explicit copy button is provided.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry of the setup secret is offered; only the raw secret string is shown.

9.why: Standard input fields are used that can work with browser autofill or password managers, but no explicit autocomplete attributes or support cues are visible.

10.why: The current step title and the primary blue action button stand out clearly on every screen.

11.why: Only one main action is requested at a time (verify, set up authenticator, or confirm code).

12.why: Logs note completed actions, but the main UI does not always plainly state what happened and what comes next after each step.

13.why: The user can retry entering the code freely after an error with no lockout or penalty visible.

14.why: The error 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' does not state the specific problem or how to fix it.

15.why: No time limit is displayed or imposed on reading or entering codes in any of the screenshots.
